summary: Backend-only retest of the new MULTI-AGENT /api/build + zip download, plus full regression of the existing suite against the public preview URL (https://jarvis-os-52.preview.emergentagent.com). 43 pytest cases, 42 passed / 1 failed. 4 real build calls were executed (LLM, ~35-42s each). CONFIRMED WORKING: /api/build is genuinely multi-agent and multi-file - it returns id + plan (~5.2k chars architecture spec) + agents ['Architect','Backend','Frontend','DevOps','Preview'] + 7-15 files with real code (ARCHITECTURE.md, README.md, docker-compose.yml, backend/Dockerfile, frontend/Dockerfile, requirements.txt, models.py, .env.example, package.json, src/api.js, src/components/*), never a single dummy HTML file; the doc persists to db.apps; GET /api/apps/{id}/zip returns a valid application/zip attachment (CRC OK) containing every generated file plus preview/index.html; zip is scoped to the owner (another user's id -> 404, unknown id -> 404); refine path returns an updated preview_html containing the requested dark-mode change with files == []; POST /api/build and GET /api/apps/{id}/zip both return 401 unauthenticated; /api/stats + /api/history/apps + delete all reflect the build. FAILING: preview_html is TRUNCATED on every single build (4/4) - no closing </html>, output cut mid-JavaScript at ~16-17k chars - so the 'working live preview' is broken HTML, and it is persisted and shipped in the zip that way. Same truncation also silently DROPS generated files: the backend agent's server.py was missing in 4/4 builds and src/App.js in 3/4 (one build produced NO backend files at all), because when the LLM hits max_tokens the last '=== path ===```' block loses its closing fence and _parse_files skips it. Regression: chat/email/research/history/admin allow-list all pass; the previously reported revocation gap and cookie-only logout are FIXED (get_current_user now calls _enforce_access -> 403 immediately after allow-list removal; logout honours Bearer) and role is now Literal['user','admin'] (invalid/escalating roles -> 422) - stale tests were updated accordingly. All seeded users/sessions/allow-list/apps purged (only the real owner's Google-login docs remain).

critical.issue: preview_html is truncated on EVERY build (4/4 runs, 100%): it starts with <!DOCTYPE html> but has no </html> and ends mid-JS at ~16-17k chars. The preview agent's max_tokens=4000 is too small for a full single-file app, and _extract_html() falls back to `raw.strip()` when the </html> regex does not match, so invalid HTML is returned, saved to db.apps and written into preview/index.html in the zip. Fix: raise max_tokens for the preview agent (~8-12k), detect truncation (missing </html>) and retry/continue or auto-close the document, and/or instruct a leaner demo.

Generated project is incomplete because the backend/frontend agents are also truncated at max_tokens=4000: FastAPI entrypoint server.py was absent in 4/4 builds and src/App.js in 3/4 (one build returned NO backend file at all - only package.json, src/api.js, README.md, docker-compose.yml, Dockerfiles). Root cause: _parse_files() requires a closing ``` fence, so the last (partial) file block is silently discarded. Fix: increase max_tokens per agent, split the backend/frontend agent into 2+ calls (or per-file calls), make _parse_files tolerate an unterminated final block, and validate that required files (server.py, src/App.js, requirements.txt, package.json) exist - retry that agent if not.

minor.issue: Generated file paths are not namespaced: backend files land at the repo root (requirements.txt, models.py, .env.example) next to frontend files (package.json, src/...), yet the DevOps agent emits backend/Dockerfile + frontend/Dockerfile and a docker-compose.yml with ./backend and ./frontend build contexts. The downloaded zip therefore cannot be built as-is. Force prefixes in the agent prompts (backend/... and frontend/...).

Race/dedupe bug observed in live data: two concurrent logins for the same email both miss the `existing` lookup and insert TWO db.users docs with different user_ids for gauravklegacy@gmail.com, plus two db.user_sessions docs with the SAME session_token. get_current_user() then picks one user_id arbitrarily, so the user's chats/emails/apps can split across two identities. Fix: upsert on email (find_one_and_update with upsert) and add unique indexes on users.email and user_sessions.session_token.
Still uses blocking requests.get() inside an async route (blocks the event loop up to 20s) and inserts a new session doc per login with no TTL index on user_sessions.expires_at.

No per-agent failure surfacing: asyncio.gather(..., return_exceptions=True) + _safe() swallows an LLM error into an empty string, so a dead agent looks like 'the model produced no files' (HTTP 200). Return per-agent status in the 'agents' field so the UI can show which agent failed.
Pre-existing: a DuckDuckGo outage is returned as HTTP 200 with a 'No live web results' summary; clients cannot distinguish outage from empty results.

action_items: Fix truncated preview_html: raise the preview agent's max_tokens and reject/retry when the response has no </html> (currently 100% of builds ship broken preview HTML into db.apps and the zip).

Fix dropped files: server.py is missing from every generated project. Raise max_tokens for the backend/frontend agents, split them into multiple calls, make _parse_files accept an unterminated final code block, and assert required files exist before returning 200.
Namespace generated paths under backend/ and frontend/ so the emitted docker-compose.yml and Dockerfiles match the zip layout.
De-duplicate users in /api/auth/session (upsert by email + unique indexes on users.email and user_sessions.session_token) - duplicate super-admin docs already exist in the live DB.
Replace blocking requests.get in /api/auth/session with httpx.AsyncClient and add a TTL index on user_sessions.expires_at.
critical_code_review_comments: _extract_html() silently returns raw text when the document is incomplete - it should signal failure so /api/build can retry instead of persisting invalid HTML.

_parse_files() regex `===\s*(.+?)\s*===\s*```lang\n(.*?)```' drops the final block when the model is cut off; also no path sanitisation - a model-emitted '../x' or absolute path would be written verbatim into the zip (zip-slip on extraction).

/api/build has no size guard: files + preview_html (~50-100 KB) are stored inline in the db.apps doc and echoed in the response; consider returning file metadata + a separate fetch, and cap document size.
SUPER_ADMIN is still hard-coded in server.py; move it to an env var.
No indexes on user_sessions.session_token / users.user_id although get_current_user queries both on every request.
server.py is 495 lines mixing auth, admin, 4 feature domains and the whole builder pipeline - extract the builder agents into builder.py before it exceeds 700 lines.

success_rate.backend: 97.7% (42/43 pytest cases; the 1 failure is the multi-agent build preview truncation, reproduced 4/4)

seed_data_creation: Mongo-seeded per-class sessions via conftest fixtures: super admin gauravklegacy@gmail.com and allow-listed test_regular_*@test.com users, plus transient allow-list entries and one synthetic db.apps doc (TEST_*) for zip ownership scoping. All purged after the run (users/user_sessions/allowed_users/chats/emails/apps contain no TEST_ data; only the owner's real Google-login docs remain).
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is accurate for the current model (super admin gauravklegacy@gmail.com + db.allowed_users). No external keys needed; tests seed db.users + db.user_sessions and send Authorization: Bearer <token>.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope). Use -n 0 -s for the build test to see printed file lists. Auth = conftest.py fixtures `super_admin` / `regular_user` (Mongo-seeded, self-purging); never call the external emergent session API. tests/backend_test.py::TestBuildAndStats::test_multiagent_build_zip_stats_and_history uses SOFT assertions (collects all findings from ONE expensive build call, ~40s) and now also asserts server.py/App.js presence - keep it to one build call per run to limit LLM cost. Known-open: preview_html truncation and missing server.py/App.js. Everything else (zip, auth 401/404, refine, stats, history, chat/email/research, admin allow-list, immediate revocation -> 403, role Literal 422) passes.
rca_of_the_issue: All build defects share one root cause: the LLM hits its max_tokens ceiling (4000) for the preview/backend/frontend agents. (1) For the preview agent the response ends mid-JS; _extract_html's `<!DOCTYPE html.*?</html>` regex fails, and the fallback `return raw.strip()` hands back an unterminated document that is stored in db.apps and written to preview/index.html. (2) For the backend/frontend agents the truncation cuts the final fenced code block, and since _parse_files requires the closing ```, that file (typically server.py or src/App.js) is dropped without warning, so the 'full-stack' project has no API entrypoint. Reproduction: POST /api/build {'idea':'a task manager with projects and a dashboard'} with a seeded Bearer session and inspect response['preview_html'][-200:] (no </html>) and [f['path'] for f in response['files']] (no server.py). Mitigation: larger/per-file agent calls, truncation detection with retry, and a required-file validation step.
